title: Auditing a Learned Simulator for Legged Robots: The Robotic World Model on ANYmal D
abstract: arXiv:2611.23118v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A legged robot can learn to walk inside a learned simulator: a neural network that predicts the robot's next state and is run forward on its own predictions. They are usually trained and checked one step ahead, although a policy uses them for a hundred steps or more. We audit one published system end to end, without a GPU: the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) for the ANYmal D quadruped, and the uncertainty estimate of its follow-up, RWM-U. We rebuilt the model to match the released code's outputs, losses and gradients exactly, measured 101 trained simulators, 200 compressed copies and 38 simulators of three other architectures, and trained policies inside simulators that we tested in a hand-built MuJoCo model of the robot. Training on the model's own rollouts beat one-step training at 368 steps on all ten held-out episodes (registered), although one-step training was better one step ahead. translated_title: 审计面向四足机器人的学习型模拟器：ANYmal D 上的机器人世界模型
translated_abstract: 四足机器人可以在一个学习到的模拟器中学会行走：该模拟器是一个神经网络，用于预测机器人的下一状态，并基于自身的预测不断向前推演。这类模拟器通常只进行单步训练和单步检验，而策略在使用它们时却需要连续推演一百步甚至更多。我们在没有 GPU 的条件下对一个已发表的系统进行了端到端审计：包括面向 ANYmal D 四足机器人的机器人世界模型（RWM）的动力学模型，及其后续工作 RWM-U 的不确定性估计。我们重建了该模型，使其与发布代码的输出、损失和梯度完全一致，测量了 101 个训练好的模拟器、200 个压缩副本以及另外三种架构下的 38 个模拟器，并在模拟器中训练策略，随后在我们手工构建的机器人 MuJoCo 模型中进行测试。结果显示，在模型自身推演数据上的训练在 368 步时于全部十个保留测试回合中都优于单步训练（结果已注册），尽管在单步预测上单步训练表现更好。因此，单步检验会误判……（原文截断于此）
tldr: 该论文对四足机器人的学习型模拟器进行了端到端审计，发现仅用单步误差评估会误判模拟器质量——尽管单步训练的模拟器单步预测更准，但在自身长时推演数据上训练的模拟器能让策略在 368 步的推演中表现更好。
en_tdlr: This paper end-to-end audits a learned simulator for the ANYmal D quadruped and shows that one-step checks misjudge simulator quality: although one-step-trained simulators predict better one step ahead, training on the model's own rollouts yields better policy performance over 368-step rollouts.
